[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.

Most organizations use separate tools for screen sharing, video calls, digital signage, and
emergency alerts — and the fragmentation slows everyone down. Airtame brings it all together in one
platform. Easy to roll out, simple to manage, and intuitive for anyone to use.

## Airtame Go: The most affordable way to make your screens useful

Get started with the Airtame essentials for less. Screen sharing, signage, alerts, and remote
management — bundled with hardware, an Ethernet adapter, a 3-year license, and a 3-year warranty.

## Meet Airtame 3, our most powerful device

Airtame 3 combines faster performance and easier deployment in one device. It’s built for scale, so
IT can roll out, manage, and update screens remotely, while users enjoy a consistent, reliable
experience across rooms.

[ Explore Airtame 3 ][39]

## Bring the Airtame experience to your own hardware

Virtual Airtame gives you the full Airtame experience — screen sharing, conferencing, signage, and
alerts — without Airtame hardware. Extend the life of your current setup, mix it with Airtame 3
where needed, and give every screen the same intuitive experience.

# Magnetic Beads – A Powerful Biotechnology tool

Magnetic Beads

A PowerfulBiotechnology tool

Magnetic Beads

A Powerful

Biotechnology tool

Magnetic beads are widely used in biotechnology for various applications such as purification,
isolation, and separation of biomolecules and cells. They are often used in combination with
specific antibodies or other targeting molecules to selectively capture target molecules from a
complex mixture. The magnetic properties of the beads allow for easy and efficient separation from
the rest of the mixture using a magnetic field. Magnetic bead-based methods are commonly used in
research, diagnostics, and bioprocessing industries.

the rest of the mixture using a magnetic field. Magnetic bead-based methods are commonly used in

As a leading CRO, **BOC Sciences** specializes in offering top-notch bioconjugation services that
cater to drug discovery and drug delivery. Our team of highly skilled scientists possesses vast
expertise in an extensive range of bioconjugation techniques. Whether it's traditional cross-linking
methods or click chemistry approaches, we have the proficiency to apply the most appropriate
technique based on the unique requirements of each project.

methods or click chemistry approaches, we have the proficiency to apply the most appropriate
technique based on the unique requirements of each project.

About BIO

The Biotechnology Innovation Organization (BIO) is the premier biotechnology advocacy organization
representing biotech companies, industry leaders, and state biotech associations in the United
States and more than 35 countries around the globe. BIO members range from biotech start-ups to some
of the world’s largest biopharmaceutical companies – all united by the same goal: to develop medical
and scientific breakthroughs that prevent and fight disease, restore health, and improve patients’
lives. BIO also organizes the BIO International Convention and a series of annual conferences that
drive partnerships, investment, and progress within the sector.

– Bradley Burnam, CEO, Turn Therapeutics
About BIO

The Biotechnology Innovation Organization (BIO) is the premier biotechnology advocacy organization
representing biotech companies, industry leaders, and state biotech associations in the United
States and more than 35 countries around the globe. BIO members range from biotech start-ups to some
of the world’s largest biopharmaceutical companies – all united by the same goal: to develop medical
and scientific breakthroughs that prevent and fight disease, restore health, and improve patients’
lives. BIO also organizes the BIO International Convention and a series of annual conferences that
drive partnerships, investment, and progress within the sector.

### Products
### 

[Multicolumn Image]

Equip your laboratory for peak performance with Copan's unmatched, expertly engineered sample
collection and transport devices and laboratory essentials.

[ Explore Products ][62]

### Laboratory Automation & AI

[Multicolumn Image]

Unlock new levels of efficiency with Copan's transformative automation and AI innovations.
Experience how our customized solutions support your team so you can focus on what matters most.

[ Learn More ][63]

### Scientific Studies
### 

[a]

Explore our full library of scientific studies documenting the proven performance of our innovative
collection devices, automation, and AI across diverse applications and workflows.

[ Find Studies ][64]

## Innovation is in Our DNA

Since 1979, Copan has combined innovation with a forward-looking vision for the laboratory,
developing early automation concepts and inventing flocked swab technology, now a global standard in
specimen collection.

 

Today, we continue to innovate with solutions that strengthen every step of the laboratory workflow,
from specimen collection and transport to processing and interpretation, integrating automation and
AI to improve efficiency and consistency.

 

Working in close collaboration with the microbiology community, we solve real laboratory challenges
so laboratories can deliver reliable results and support better patient care.

## FDA-Cleared Innovation

PhenoMATRIX^{®}, Copan’s AI-powered image assessment software for WASPLab^{®} automation, is now FDA
510(k) cleared in the United States.
By automatically sorting culture plate images using artificial intelligence and laboratory-defined
rules, PhenoMATRIX helps laboratories streamline plate review, improve efficiency, and maintain
expert control.

## Innovation is in Our DNA

Since 1979, Copan has combined innovation with a forward-looking vision for the laboratory,
developing early automation concepts and inventing flocked swab technology, now a global standard in
specimen collection.

 

Today, we continue to innovate with solutions that strengthen every step of the laboratory workflow,
from specimen collection and transport to processing and interpretation, integrating automation and
AI to improve efficiency and consistency.

 

Working in close collaboration with the microbiology community, we solve real laboratory challenges
so laboratories can deliver reliable results and support better patient care.

## FDA-Cleared Innovation

PhenoMATRIX^{®}, Copan’s AI-powered image assessment software for WASPLab^{®} automation, is now FDA
510(k) cleared in the United States.
By automatically sorting culture plate images using artificial intelligence and laboratory-defined
rules, PhenoMATRIX helps laboratories streamline plate review, improve efficiency, and maintain
expert control.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## What our customers are saying
* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only
  trace was a small edit buried in their developer docs. ForesightIQ flagged it."
  
  [Mitch Eger]
  Mitch EgerProduct Marketing Manager, Polygon Labs
* ### Signals incumbent tools miss
  
  "Crayon missed an entire Square ads campaign. ForesightIQ caught it — screenshots and all — and
  it's directly shaped how our Brand team positioned our next campaign."
  
  [Min Chi]
  Min ChiSenior Manager, Insights, Public SaaS Company
* ### Future focused insights
  
  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

## Beyond the usual sources

industry.

world-renowned with comprehensive COA documentation for every shipment.

quantities from gram to ton scale.

leader in research peptide manufacturing.

peptides delivered within one week, refined and purified peptides within two weeks — giving
customers maximum time to seize research opportunities.

Gold Standard Diagnostics is a global network of companies with decades of experience on the test
kit, reagent and instrument development and manufacturing market.

We provide fast, reliable, and easy to use diagnostic assays and instruments in the fields of
bioanalytical testing for the food, feed, environmental, biopharma, animal health and clinical
industries.

Our brand name underlines our ambition to provide Gold Standard, the best possible laboratory
diagnostic solutions with all our applications.

We are deeply engaged in the innovative development, quality manufacturing, and the outstanding
commercialization and technical support of our diagnostic solutions.

The in-house R&D teams have expertise in developing a wide range of innovative methods and
applications to meet the testing needs of both research and industry.

bioanalytical testing for the food, feed, environmental, biopharma, animal health and clinical
industries.

Our brand name underlines our ambition to provide Gold Standard, the best possible laboratory
diagnostic solutions with all our applications.

We are deeply engaged in the innovative development, quality manufacturing, and the outstanding
commercialization and technical support of our diagnostic solutions.

The in-house R&D teams have expertise in developing a wide range of innovative methods and
applications to meet the testing needs of both research and industry.

quality standards.

# Growjo

## The Fastest Growing Companies w/ Contacts & Emails

# Growjo tracks the fastest growing private companies and startups in the world. Using annual
# revenue, competitor/alternative analysis, “number of employees” growth, funding news, sales &
# financials, valuation increases and other growth triggers, we have created the list below of the
# Top 10,000 companies for the Spring of 2026. Because this list is focused on startups with
# traction, to qualify the company must have between 15 and 1,000 employees. In addition to the
# exportable list below, you can check our contact data for these companies that includes email
# addresses and direct phone numbers. Within the pages you will find quality alternatives to the
# said company as well. Or use our search bar to enrich or [find revenue for private companies][9].

## Looking for a specific test?

Search
Prescription help

## Have a prescription but not sure which tests to add?

Patients can search the catalog directly, or share prescription details during checkout so the JCRL
team can confirm the right test names before collection.

[Add tests from catalog][52][Email prescription][53]
[Patient handing prescription to a diagnostic care professional]

## Home collection without losing laboratory control.

JCRL's process makes collection easier for patients while protecting the integrity of the sample
from pickup to testing.

1

#### Sample collected by trained staff

A qualified phlebotomist visits your home.

2

#### Transported in designed packets

Secure logistics protect sample integrity.

3

#### Tested at NABL central lab

Quality control monitoring at every stage.

4

#### Report delivered online

Secure, fast, and reviewed by pathologists.

[Book Home Collection][54]
[JCRL home collection visit with sample preparation]

Technology Matters

Advanced laboratory platforms support biochemistry, immunoassay, hematology, and molecular
workflows.

## Why patients, families, and partners trust JCRL

The value of a diagnostics network lies in consistency: trained handling, disciplined quality
systems, responsive service, and results that can be relied upon.

#### NABL-aligned quality discipline

Quality systems, review protocols, and laboratory control help maintain confidence in every report.

#### Careful sample movement

Transport and handling matter because sample integrity affects the final result.

#### Secure report access

Patients can retrieve reports digitally while still receiving support when clarification is needed.

#### Experienced laboratory oversight

Scientific supervision and professional review remain central to the reporting process.

## Specialised departments within the JCRL laboratory system

A serious diagnostics network depends on focused departments, appropriate analytical methods, and
trained scientific teams working within clear laboratory boundaries.

[Explore Our Quality ][55]

### Molecular Diagnostics

Supports high-sensitivity work such as infectious marker analysis and specialised molecular
investigations where routine methods are not sufficient.

RT-PCRViral Load HCV/HBVHLA-B27

### Biochemistry

Handles routine and specialised chemistry testing for organ function, metabolic balance, and
broad-profile screening needs.

Kidney ProfileLiver FunctionElectrolytes

### Immunology

Supports hormone testing, vitamin studies, tumor markers, and serology through platform-specific
analytical methods.

Thyroid PanelVitamin DTumor Markers

### Histopathology

Provides tissue-based diagnostic support where microscopic examination is essential for deeper
clinical assessment.

BiopsiesCytologyIHC

### Hematology

Supports blood counts, coagulation review, and advanced blood-cell analysis for routine and
specialised diagnostic needs.

CBC AnalysisCoagulation ProfileHbA1c

### Microbiology

Supports culture-driven and infection-focused testing where organism detection and sensitivity
patterns are clinically important.

Urine CultureBlood CultureFungal Smear

## Support designed around three kinds of trust

JCRL serves patients, clinicians, and partner centres with different needs, but the same expectation
of reliability.

1

### For patients

Clear booking pathways, home collection support, digital report access, and assistance when test
names or preparation steps are unclear.

Verified against JCRL service scope

2

### For doctors

A broad test menu, structured laboratory workflows, and a diagnostics partner that values scientific
clarity and responsiveness.

Verified against JCRL service scope

3

### For partners

Operational support, logistics, consumables, training, and a laboratory backbone designed for
network reliability.

Verified against JCRL service scope

Leadership behind JCRL

## An organisation earns credibility through people, standards, and continuity.

JCRL's direction is shaped by leadership that balances laboratory discipline, operational
seriousness, and a sustained commitment to patient trust.

[Dr. Simpi Rani, Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics]

“Every diagnostic result carries a duty of care. Our responsibility is to make that process clear,
careful, and professionally accountable.”

### Dr. Simpi Rani

Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics

[Mr. Sanjeev Mishra, Managing Director, JCRL Diagnostics]

“A diagnostics network becomes dependable when service, logistics, reporting, and operational
discipline improve together over time.”

### Mr. Sanjeev Mishra

Managing Director, JCRL Diagnostics

[Doctor and patient discussing diagnostic care]

Start with the service route that fits you best, whether that means booking online, arranging home

team can confirm the right test names before collection.

## Home collection without losing laboratory control.

JCRL's process makes collection easier for patients while protecting the integrity of the sample
from pickup to testing.

1

#### Sample collected by trained staff

A qualified phlebotomist visits your home.

2

#### Transported in designed packets

Secure logistics protect sample integrity.

3

#### Tested at NABL central lab

Quality control monitoring at every stage.

4

#### Report delivered online

Secure, fast, and reviewed by pathologists.

[Book Home Collection][54]
[JCRL home collection visit with sample preparation]

Technology Matters

Advanced laboratory platforms support biochemistry, immunoassay, hematology, and molecular
workflows.

## Why patients, families, and partners trust JCRL

The value of a diagnostics network lies in consistency: trained handling, disciplined quality
systems, responsive service, and results that can be relied upon.

#### NABL-aligned quality discipline

Quality systems, review protocols, and laboratory control help maintain confidence in every report.

#### Careful sample movement

Transport and handling matter because sample integrity affects the final result.

#### Secure report access

Patients can retrieve reports digitally while still receiving support when clarification is needed.

#### Experienced laboratory oversight

Scientific supervision and professional review remain central to the reporting process.

## Specialised departments within the JCRL laboratory system

A serious diagnostics network depends on focused departments, appropriate analytical methods, and
trained scientific teams working within clear laboratory boundaries.

[Explore Our Quality ][55]

### Molecular Diagnostics

Supports high-sensitivity work such as infectious marker analysis and specialised molecular
investigations where routine methods are not sufficient.

RT-PCRViral Load HCV/HBVHLA-B27

### Biochemistry

Handles routine and specialised chemistry testing for organ function, metabolic balance, and
broad-profile screening needs.

Kidney ProfileLiver FunctionElectrolytes

### Immunology

Supports hormone testing, vitamin studies, tumor markers, and serology through platform-specific
analytical methods.

Thyroid PanelVitamin DTumor Markers

### Histopathology

Provides tissue-based diagnostic support where microscopic examination is essential for deeper
clinical assessment.

BiopsiesCytologyIHC

### Hematology

Supports blood counts, coagulation review, and advanced blood-cell analysis for routine and
specialised diagnostic needs.

CBC AnalysisCoagulation ProfileHbA1c

### Microbiology

Supports culture-driven and infection-focused testing where organism detection and sensitivity
patterns are clinically important.

Urine CultureBlood CultureFungal Smear

## Support designed around three kinds of trust

JCRL serves patients, clinicians, and partner centres with different needs, but the same expectation
of reliability.

1

### For patients

Clear booking pathways, home collection support, digital report access, and assistance when test
names or preparation steps are unclear.

Verified against JCRL service scope

2

### For doctors

A broad test menu, structured laboratory workflows, and a diagnostics partner that values scientific
clarity and responsiveness.

Verified against JCRL service scope

3

### For partners

Operational support, logistics, consumables, training, and a laboratory backbone designed for
network reliability.

Verified against JCRL service scope

Leadership behind JCRL

## An organisation earns credibility through people, standards, and continuity.

JCRL's direction is shaped by leadership that balances laboratory discipline, operational
seriousness, and a sustained commitment to patient trust.

About Us

Established in Biobay, Suzhou in 2007, NanoMicro is the world leader in the manufacture of
spherical, mono-disperse particles utilizing our proprietary manufacturing processes which enable
high yield, cost effective production of such particles for a wide variety of industries and
applications. NanoMicro`s products cover a broad spectrum of applications including high performance
Chromatography Media, solid phase extraction (SPE) sorbents, Particle Size Standards,Magnetic
Particles, LCD Spacers, ACF Conductive Particles, and various other micro particles. Our
chromatography products are available in a variety of polymer formats with particle sizes from
analytical through to preparative scale. Our proprietary expertise in controlling particle
morphology and surface chemistry can be precisely tailored to optimize for solutes ranging from the
smallest API to large constructs such as viruses and viral vectors. A wide range of surface
chemistries is available from RPC/chiral for small molecules to ion exchange/affinity for
biomolecules. We manufacture mono-disperse particles of wide range of sizes. With more than 10
product lines and over 5000 products, we serve a variety of rapidly growing industry segments.
NanoMicro has two ISO 9001-certified manufacturing sites, one in Suzhou Industrial Park and another
in Changshu to ensure security of supply for our customers. Both facilities use the same well-
defined processes with production capacity of more than 200,000 Liter of resins and 24,000 kg of
silica products per year with batch sizes up to 1000 L or 200 kg. NanoMicro`s manufacturing and
quality system are available for customer audits. Additionally, our strong R&D and applications
teams ensure sustainable innovation and can provide custom solutions such as custom resin
development and purification process development.

quality system are available for customer audits. Additionally, our strong R&D and applications

## [ PicoImmune Co. ][72]

NanoBiotec, LLC (d/b/a, PicoImmune Co.) is a privately held contract research organization (CRO)
dedicated to increasing the efficiency of discovering and developing novel therapeutic drugs.

PicoImmune was founded by scientists, is run by scientists, and works for scientists. Our services,
designed by our immunologists and cancer biologists, have been sought after by a wide range of
scientific institutions from startups to major pharma and biotech companies, along with well-known
academic institutions. 

## Our Vision

To provide ultra-sensitive and reliable bioassay services to monitor real-time changes in genes and
proteins from minimal cell culture, animal, and patient samples to accelerate the discovery and
development of novel therapeutics.

## Our Mission

We provide high-quality and cost-effective services to the biopharma industry and academic
investigators to accelerate discovery and development of novel drugs and personalized medicine for
cancer, inflammation, and other diseases with unmet needs.

Our mission is to provide maximal insights from a minimal amount of sample and accelerate the
translation of high-caliber innovations to therapeutics as efficiently as possible for the benefit
of our clients and patients today, rather than in the future.

[cfa5a7f971aa09079c82ca02557f9fa52bee0c1add589785df905a53b9aa]

## Our Values
* **ACCOUNTABILITY.** We strive to obtain the best data possible and offer to repeat the experiment,
  if necessary, to remedy errors or other observed anomalies.
* **HONESTY.** We provide reliable data for each project and demonstrate ethics, integrity, and
  quality in everything we do for our clients and collaborators.
* **INCLUSION.** We embrace diversity and foster an environment where we can all work together at
  our full potential.
* **INNOVATION.** We explore new solutions for efficiency and quality.
* **PASSION.** We are proud of our work and desire to achieve scientific excellence and success.
* **PRECISION.** We ensure accurate and high-quality results by strictly adhering to our
  standardized workflows.
* **PROFESSION

NanoBiotec, LLC (d/b/a, PicoImmune Co.) is a privately held contract research organization (CRO)
dedicated to increasing the efficiency of discovering and developing novel therapeutic drugs.

PicoImmune was founded by scientists, is run by scientists, and works for scientists. Our services,
designed by our immunologists and cancer biologists, have been sought after by a wide range of
scientific institutions from startups to major pharma and biotech companies, along with well-known
academic institutions. 

## Our Vision

To provide ultra-sensitive and reliable bioassay services to monitor real-time changes in genes and
proteins from minimal cell culture, animal, and patient samples to accelerate the discovery and
development of novel therapeutics.

## Our Mission

We provide high-quality and cost-effective services to the biopharma industry and academic
investigators to accelerate discovery and development of novel drugs and personalized medicine for
cancer, inflammation, and other diseases with unmet needs.

Our mission is to provide maximal insights from a minimal amount of sample and accelerate the
translation of high-caliber innovations to therapeutics as efficiently as possible for the benefit
of our clients and patients today, rather than in the future.

* **ACCOUNTABILITY.** We strive to obtain the best data possible and offer to repeat the experiment,
  if necessary, to remedy errors or other observed anomalies.
* **HONESTY.** We provide reliable data for each project and demonstrate ethics, integrity, and
  quality in everything we do for our clients and collaborators.
* **INCLUSION.** We embrace diversity and foster an environment where we can all work together at
  our full potential.
* **INNOVATION.** We explore new solutions for efficiency and quality.
* **PASSION.** We are proud of our work and desire to achieve scientific excellence and success.
* **PRECISION.** We ensure accurate and high-quality results by strictly adhering to our
  standardized workflows.
* **PROFESSIONALISM.** We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards while striving to be
  flexible to provide outstanding services.
* **PROFICIENCY.** We harness the power of our state-of-the-art instruments and platforms to provide
  unique and comprehensive solutions.
* **RESPECT.** We carefully listen to our clients’ requirements and strictly follow project
  timelines.
* **SIMPLICITY.** We aim to make projects simpler and easier.
* **TRANSPARENCY.** We are open to all communications to ensure transparent partnership.
* **URGENCY.** We move together with speed and quality because clients and patients are waiting.

## Our Team
* Our team has unparalleled drug discovery, bioanalytical, genomic and proteomic expertise. Our
  scientists have been well-trained at world-class institutes (such as MIT, NIH, MSKCC, Mount Sinai
  Medical School, Rutgers, and NYU) and have decades of working experience with multinational
  biopharma companies, including Novartis, Sanofi, Merck, BMS/Celgene, and Regeneron. We obtain and
  interpret data from multiple experiments to evaluate drug efficacy and address potential
  mechanisms behind drugs and diseases.
* Our scientists are well-versed in developing various cellular and molecular assays to understand
  drug efficacy by monitoring real-time changes of gene and protein expression in samples from cell
  cultures, animal models, and patients at a pico level.

## Our Platforms

We have established a unique infrastructure with cutting-edge technologies and state-of-the-art
instruments. Our suite of advanced platforms enables highly sensitive bioanalysis and drug screening
using minimal amount of sample, which allows us to meet various desired assay performance
requirements.

The passionate scientists at PicoImmune have extensive hands-on experience and training with these
technologies and instruments and stringently follow well-validated protocols to process and analyze
samples quickly and accurately.

* [Miltenyi Biotec autoMACS® Pro Separator ][82]

At PicoImmune, our strategy is focused on building R&D partnerships with biotech, pharmaceutical,

## [ PicoImmune Co. ][72]

NanoBiotec, LLC (d/b/a, PicoImmune Co.) is a privately held contract research organization (CRO)
dedicated to increasing the efficiency of discovering and developing novel therapeutic drugs.

PicoImmune was founded by scientists, is run by scientists, and works for scientists. Our services,
designed by our immunologists and cancer biologists, have been sought after by a wide range of
scientific institutions from startups to major pharma and biotech companies, along with well-known
academic institutions. 

## Our Vision

To provide ultra-sensitive and reliable bioassay services to monitor real-time changes in genes and
proteins from minimal cell culture, animal, and patient samples to accelerate the discovery and
development of novel therapeutics.

## Our Mission

We provide high-quality and cost-effective services to the biopharma industry and academic
investigators to accelerate discovery and development of novel drugs and personalized medicine for
cancer, inflammation, and other diseases with unmet needs.

Our mission is to provide maximal insights from a minimal amount of sample and accelerate the
translation of high-caliber innovations to therapeutics as efficiently as possible for the benefit
of our clients and patients today, rather than in the future.

[cfa5a7f971aa09079c82ca02557f9fa52bee0c1add589785df905a53b9aa]

## Our Values
* **ACCOUNTABILITY.** We strive to obtain the best data possible and offer to repeat the experiment,
  if necessary, to remedy errors or other observed anomalies.
* **HONESTY.** We provide reliable data for each project and demonstrate ethics, integrity, and
  quality in everything we do for our clients and collaborators.
* **INCLUSION.** We embrace diversity and foster an environment where we can all work together at
  our full potential.
* **INNOVATION.** We explore new solutions for efficiency and quality.
* **PASSION.** We are proud of our work and desire to achieve scientific excellence and success.
* **PRECISION.** We ensure accurate and high-quality results by strictly adhering to our
  standardized workflows.
* **PROFESSIONALISM.** We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards while striving to be
  flexible to provide outstanding services.
* **PROFICIENCY.** We harness the power of our state-of-the-art instruments and platforms to provide
  unique and comprehensive solutions.
* **RESPECT.** We carefully listen to our clients’ requirements and strictly follow project
  timelines.
* **SIMPLICITY.** We aim to make projects simpler and easier.
* **TRANSPARENCY.** We are open to all communications to ensure transparent partnership.
* **URGENCY.** We move together with speed and quality because clients and patients are waiting.

## Our Team
* Our team has unparalleled drug discovery, bioanalytical, genomic and proteomic expertise. Our
  scientists have been well-trained at world-class institutes (such as MIT, NIH, MSKCC, Mount Sinai
  Medical School, Rutgers, and NYU) and have decades of working experience with multinational
  biopharma companies, including Novartis, Sanofi, Merck, BMS/Celgene, and Regeneron. We obtain and
  interpret data from multiple experiments to evaluate drug efficacy and address potential
  mechanisms behind drugs and diseases.
* Our scientists are well-versed in developing various cellular and molecular assays to understand
  drug efficacy by monitoring real-time changes of gene and protein expression in samples from cell
  cultures, animal models, and patients at a pico level.

## Our Platforms

We have established a unique infrastructure with cutting-edge technologies and state-of-the-art
instruments. Our suite of advanced platforms enables highly sensitive bioanalysis and drug screening
using minimal amount of sample, which allows us to meet various desired assay performance
requirements.

The passionate scientists at PicoImmune have extensive hands-on experience and training with these
technologies and instruments and stringently follow well-validated protocols to process and analyze
samples quickly and accurately.

### Previous page

### Next page

#### Product Categories

SAT NANO is a professional supplier of nano powder and micro powder. Its products include metal
powder, oxide powder, carbide powder, nitride powder and other powders.
* [[3D printing service]][178]
  
  #### [3D printing service][179]
  
  SLM metal sintering printing, SLS nylon sintering printing, MJP high-precision resin printing,
  HSLA laser curing printing, SLA laser curing printing
* [[Element nanopowder]][180]
  
  #### [Element nanopowder][181]
  
  Supply copper, silver, Zinc, Iron, Titanium, Nickel, Tungsten, Stannum, Molybdenum, Boron, Cobalt
  nanopowder. They are with nano-sized particle size, strict particle size control, high sphericity,
  small agglomerated particles, and concentrated particle size distribution.
* [[Metal Oxide nanopowder]][182]
  
  #### [Metal Oxide nanopowder][183]
  
  Supply silica, tungsten oxide, zinc oxide, titanium oxide, zirconium dioxide, iron oxide, copper
  oxide, cobalt oxide nanopowder. They are with nano-sized particle size, strict particle size
  control, high sphericity, small agglomerated particles, and concentrated particle size
  distribution.
* [[Metal Alloy nanopowder]][184]
  
  #### [Metal Alloy nanopowder][185]
  
  Supply Cu-Ni, Fe-Ni, Tungsten copper, AlSi nanopowder. They are with nano-sized particle size,
  strict particle size control, high sphericity, small agglomerated particles, and concentrated
  particle size distribution.
* [[Nitride nanopowder]][186]
  
  #### [Nitride nanopowder][187]
  
  Supply silicon nitride, aluminum nitride, boron nitride, titanium nitride nanopowder. They are
  with nano-sized particle size, strict particle size control, high sphericity, small agglomerated
  particles, and concentrated particle size distribution.
